title: Redesign admin showtime cards into compact, scannable accordion
body:
## Summary
Reworks the per-showtime cards on the admin dashboard so an operator can scan/compare many showtimes at a glance, then expand one for full analytics. **UI/UX only** — no controller/query/metric/DB changes, no new dependencies. All edits are in `resources/views/admin/dashboard.blade.php` (markup, the scoped `.sta-*` `<style>` block, and the accordion JS).

The collapsed state previously rendered each KPI as a bordered box in a 4-col grid plus a price line plus an expand row, making cards tall and mostly empty when values were `0`. The new collapsed state is a fixed, compact summary:

```
🎭 Show name                         🟢 Status
📅 date   🕔 time
⬤82% إشغال  ⬤186,000 ج  ⬤240 المتبقي  ⬤560 معتمد   ← KPI chips
                                     عرض التفاصيل ▾
```

Key changes:
- **Giant KPI boxes → `.sta-chip` pills**: one wrapping "ticker" row of `dot + bold value + tiny label`. Occupancy = cyan, revenue = emerald, remaining = neutral, approved = green, reusing existing PRISM tokens.
- **Price line moved out of the compact header into the expanded body** (it isn't needed for fast comparison).
- **Whole summary is one large touch target**: `role="button"` + `tabindex="0"` + `aria-expanded`, with Enter/Space keyboard support added to the accordion JS.
- **Stronger active state**: open card gets a border glow + cyan accent rail (`inset box-shadow`) on its summary; arrow rotation now driven by CSS (`.is-expanded .sta-expand-arrow`) instead of inline style.
- Expanded body (occupancy ring, status tiles, stacked bar, revenue split, hall/balcony, advanced metrics) is unchanged aside from receiving the relocated price line.

Verified locally against a seeded dashboard: cards render compactly (2-up on desktop, ~4 visible at once), expand/collapse toggles the glow/arrow/`aria-expanded` and "عرض/إخفاء التفاصيل" label, and the relocated price + full analytics show on expand. `npm run build` (Tailwind) succeeds.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/99e32bfd850d4b99b8e4458d7d4e09f0
Requested by: @jonathan123551
